newsitems.title: Dominions 6.36
newsitems.author: johan
newsitems.contents:
This update adds a touchscreen mode, useful for when you want to play using a touchscreen and with no or little keyboard use. With this mode enabled a long-click will be changed into a right click and scrolling can be done by everywhere by dragging. See the popup in settings for more hints on using the touchscreen mode.

There is also a few small features added as well as a bunch of bugs fixed, most importantly a battle replay inconsistency that sometimes occurred after watching a previous battle past round 99.

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Touchscreen mode
[*] Right click to raise/lower PD by 10
[*] Right click on 't' for 'y'
[*] Use up/down keys to swap research targets
[*] Added ? help on research screen
[*] Press 's' to hide temp summons in battle overview
[*] New sprite for Mountain Vila
[*] Fix for some commanders having an incorrect sprite when unmounted
[*] Research scoregraph could fail to show leader at the top
[*] Fix for Shark Attack / Morrigans being affected by death of vegetation
[*] Gift of water breathing ability can now protect against Lost Land
[*] Swimming mounts are now enough to cross rivers
[*] Perpetual Storm increased move cost in caves/underwater too
[*] Cancel load pretender loaded bless effects anyway, fixed
[*] Rust didn't take effect when causing no damage at all
[*] Changing items on blood sacrificer no longer removes order
[*] Battle replay inconsistency could occur if watching previous battle past round 99
[*] If a knight is charmed in a tavern encounter, his mount will now also change side afterwards
[*] Repeat recruited mounted commanders could sometime cost gold to remove from queue
[*] Space can now be used to clear filter when selecting a spell
[*] Fix for telporting indeps trying to go into cave walls
[*] Event fixes
[*] Typo and stat fixes
[/list]

[b]Modding / Map Making[/b]
[list]
[*] New event commands: #healaffmount, #gainaffmount, #req_provnbr, #newnbor, #remnbor
[*] Added spec2 bitmask for spell modding
[*] Better at clearing stuff when changing between mods
[/list]
